name: TickTick
description: TickTick is a to-do list and calendar app that helps users capture ideas, organize tasks, and manage time with multiple planning views, habit tracking, and built-in focus tools, syncing in real time across devices.
best_for: Positioned for individuals who want a to-do list combined with calendar planning, habit tracking, and time-blocking in one free-to-start app.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 9 lists, 99 tasks per list, basic calendar view, core task features.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: The only price shown on TickTick's official web pricing page is annual-only, US$49.99/year (about $4.17/month equivalent) — no monthly-billing option is listed on the website itself. Adds 299 lists/999 tasks per list, multiple calendar views, task duration, email reminders, and the Eisenhower Matrix. Mobile app-store subscriptions list separate monthly options around $2.99-3.99/month through Apple's own billing, not through ticktick.com.

cons: The official website pricing page shows only one price point, $49.99/year billed annually — there is no monthly subscription option published on ticktick.com itself; monthly billing exists only through mobile app-store in-app purchases at different figures.
Premium gates features many competing to-do apps offer for free, including multiple calendar views, task-duration display, and email reminders.
No team, business, or organization plan is published anywhere on the official site — TickTick's public pricing is consumer-only, with no disclosed multi-seat or admin-console pricing for teams.
features: Multiple calendar views: yearly, monthly, weekly, daily, and agenda
Kanban boards, timeline view, and Eisenhower Matrix for prioritization
Built-in Pomodoro timer for focus sessions
Habit tracker with statistics and flexible tracking options
Natural language processing for automatic date and time recognition
Task sharing and assignment for collaboration
